items.prompt:
Elements heavier than hydrogen are first made in stars by
A) nuclear fusion
B) burning
C) freezing
D) erosion

Stars first fuse hydrogen into
A) helium
B) gold
C) oxygen
D) uranium

The heaviest elements, like gold, are produced in
A) supernova explosions
B) rain
C) campfires
D) the ocean

A supernova is
A) the explosion of a large star
B) a small planet
C) a comet
D) a type of rock
items.answer: A) the explosion of a large star

steps: A supernova is an exploding large star.

items.prompt:
New stars and planets can contain heavy elements because
A) earlier stars made and spread them
B) they create elements instantly
C) heavy elements come from the Moon
D) there are no heavy elements
items.answer: A) earlier stars made and spread them

steps: New bodies form from enriched material.

items.prompt:
The atoms in your body were
A) made in stars long ago
B) made on Earth only
C) never made
D) made last year
items.answer: A) made in stars long ago

steps: Stars made the elements in your body.

items.prompt:
How do supernovas differ from ordinary stellar fusion in element formation?
A) Supernovas make the heaviest elements that ordinary fusion cannot
B) Supernovas make only hydrogen
C) They make no elements
D) They are the same
items.answer: A) Supernovas make the heaviest elements that ordinary fusion cannot

items.prompt:
The best communication of how the universe's elements formed is that
A) stars make elements by fusion and supernovas make the heaviest, then they spread through space
B) all elements were always here
C) elements come from the Moon
D) elements cannot be made
items.answer: A) stars make elements by fusion and supernovas make the heaviest, then they spread through space

steps: Fusion and supernovas produce and spread the elements.
